$comment: Policy of scripts/license-gate.mjs (npm run license:check) for every package the production dependencies reach; devDependencies are build and test tooling and never ship. SPDX identifiers, compared without regard to case. 'allowed' lists permissive licenses (OFL-1.1 for the bundled font). 'forbidden' and 'forbiddenPatterns' name strong and weak copyleft, non-commercial, no-derivatives and source-available licenses, which fail with a clear reason; any other license is unknown and fails too until someone reviews it and adds it here. 'packages' records a reviewed fact for one release whose metadata carries no usable license: key 'name@version', value { license, evidence }, where evidence links to the license text of exactly that release. 'notShipped' names packages the production tree reaches but the browser build never bundles, with the reason; the gate skips them and scripts/build.mjs fails if one of them is bundled after all. 'excluded' names packages that no bundle may contain although a bundled library imports them (an optional part under a forbidden license), with the reason; scripts/build.mjs replaces each with a module that throws when loaded. The frame scripts may bundle devDependencies (the render frame bundles mermaid), so scripts/build.mjs also judges the license of every package a frame script contains by this policy.

sharp.reason: Node-only image backend of @huggingface/transformers (LGPL libvips binaries). The browser build resolves the package's web entry (dist/transformers.web.js), which does not import it.

elkjs.reason: EPL-2.0. The optional ELK layout engine of mermaid (a devDependency that only the render frame, public/render-frame.js, bundles). Mermaid loads it lazily; without it a diagram that asks for the ELK layout shows its source with a note, and every other layout works.
